Folks — attaching the latest manifest and a short playbook excerpt for onshore fallback. Key notes:

- Current subprocessors (as of 2026-05-10): 
  * ComputeOps LLC — US (primary inference compute; encryption at rest enabled)
  * EdgeServe GmbH — EU (edge cache; no request-level telemetry stored)
  * TelemetryStore Pty — APAC (aggregated telemetry; will be phased to onshore fallback for PHI-adjacent datasets)

- Telemetry classification: we tag telemetry by category; PHI-adjacent telemetry is excluded from cross-border replication by default when customer opts-in.
- Onshore fallback options: automated failover to US region (72-hour DR window) or manual emergency transfer with written notice. Proposed clause in annex covers both options.

Attachments: subprocessors_20260510.csv, onshore-fallback-playbook.pdf (excerpt)

I also added a suggested tight deletion SLA language (30 days to purge user-level traces after request; aggregated metrics retained 90 days) — happy to tighten if MedControl requires faster windows.

-Karthik
